new_algorithm: Queue state includes remaining required nodes and ordered checkpoint cursor; capped unconstrained results are not post-filtered.

Missing goal prerequisites are retained as policy exclusions; step lower bound preserves unmet conditions.
Depth/transition/result caps preserve frontier, queued prefixes and unexamined sibling count.
